user_story: As a user, I want to be able to navigate through the floating menu links so that I can access different sections of the application easily. Acceptance Criteria: When I click on the 'Home' link, I should remain on the same page and see the URL unchanged. When I click on the 'News' link, I should also see the same page and the URL should not change. All links in the menu must be visible: 'Home', 'News', 'Contact', 'About', and 'Elemental Selenium'.
